2607.21183.title: Representative Sets in Propositional Abduction
2607.21183.paper_summary: The propositional abduction problem is a well-known form of non-monotonic reasoning where we are asked to find an explanation of a given manifestation. Recently, there has been an influx of results asking more refined questions about the solution space rather than only individual solutions. For example, we might be interested in finding two solutions that are sufficiently far from each other (diverse solutions) in the solution space. In this paper we consider a related representation question where we ask if a given set of explanations S can represent any other explanation (that is, whether their symmetric difference is smaller than a given k). We first study this problem from a classical complexity perspective and obtain a complete classification. While only a handful of cases are tractable, the increase in complexity compared to classical abduction is often smaller than expected. We then study the parameterized complexity for several parameters and obtain new tractable and hard cases. Interestingly, a full parameterized complexity classification would require resolving the parameterized complexity of the covering radius problem from coding theory. To the best of our knowledge, no useful relationship between coding theory and non-monotonic reasoning has previously been established, but such connections seemingly become important when asking more complex questions about solution spaces.
2607.21183.paper_summary_zh: 命題推理問題是一種眾所周知的非單調推理形式，要求我們找到給定現象的解釋。最近，對於解決空間的更精細問題的結果有所增加，而不僅僅是單個解決方案。例如，我們可能會對在解決空間中找到兩個足夠遠離彼此的解決方案（多樣化解決方案）感興趣。在本文中，我們考慮一個相關的表示問題，即我們詢問給定的解釋集 S 是否可以表示任何其他解釋（也就是說，它們的對稱差是否小於給定的 k）。我們首先從經典複雜性角度研究這個問題，並獲得完整的分類。雖然只有少數情況是可處理的，但與經典推理相比，複雜性的增加通常比預期的要小。然後，我們研究了幾個參數的參數化複雜性，並獲得了新的可處理和困難的案例。有趣的是，完整的參數化複雜性分類將需要解決編碼理論中的覆蓋半徑問題的參數化複雜性。據我們所知，編碼理論與非單調推理之間尚未建立有用的關係，但當詢問有關解決空間的更複雜問題時，這種聯繫似乎變得重要。
